mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_write_results WHERE identity_id = #{identity} AND idempotency_key = #{key} AND completed_at <= clock_timestamp() - interval '24 hours'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_write_results (identity_id, idempotency_key, tenant_id, fingerprint) VALUES (#{identity}, #{key}, #{tenant}, #{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint, status, body, location FROM project_write_results WHERE identity_id = #{identity} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE project_write_results SET status = #{result.status}, body = #{result.body}, location = #{result.location}, completed_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE identity_id = #{key.identity} AND idempotency_key = #{key.key} AND status IS NULL
